case_name: E-commerce missing canonical + JSON-LD + security headers

fixes.fix_explanation: Adds a canonical URL tag to prevent duplicate content issues and consolidate SEO value. This tells search engines this is the primary version of the page.
fixes.fix_location: Inside <head>, after the meta description tag

fixes.fix_explanation: Adds structured data in JSON-LD format that helps search engines understand the product details, improving rich snippet visibility and SEO performance.
Configure your web server (Apache, Nginx, etc.) to send this header with all responses. This prevents MIME-type sniffing attacks and improves security.
